description: RESET arrives for a stream id greater than highest_opened -- it was never opened, so this cannot be a benign race. OVERVIEW.md section 2.5 receiving table, row 'id > highest_opened (never opened)': every frame type including RESET -> conn PROTOCOL_ERROR. Companion to data_for_never_opened_stream_toward_client.json (same row, different frame type) and to reset_on_closed_stream_toward_client.json (same frame type, the other row of the table -- id <= highest_opened with no live stream, which is benign).
